title: SIOS Registry Manifest
description: Canonical machine-readable contract for runtime validation. Artifact values remain source-backed and do not override governance decisions.

source_document.description: Source document used to prepare the manifest, or null when no single source is asserted.

status.description: Preserve the source status wording; null means unresolved, not inferred.

version.description: Version as stated in the source; null means not specified.

path.description: Repository-relative path; null means not yet verified.

record_state.description: Explicit means one ID is stated directly. Grouped/ambiguous records must not be silently expanded.

source_location.description: Section, heading, or row locator in the source document.
